notes: Per-asset metadata for the Utterbar marketing pack. `id` must match a Remotion composition id in src/Root.tsx. Filenames follow `<id>.mp4` + `<id>-poster.png` for videos and `<id>.png` for stills. Placements are a hint for the website build — the marketing site is free to use its own routing.
